clarifications_needed: Geography is named in the README as city/metro clusters (Phoenix, Philadelphia metro, NorCal, Salt Lake, Florida, Tri-State; SoCal excluded) rather than state codes — zip_bands unfilled pending a mapping pass against BN service-territory boundaries

size_band uses employee bands plus operating budget as revenue proxy (large: $5M–$50M operating budget / 200K+ visitors; mid-tier: $1M–$10M / 100K–200K visitors; events budgets $250K–$2M and $25K–$100K respectively) — visitor and events-budget thresholds are README ICP firmographics that don't map to schema keys; encode via list filters
Director of Development persona is inferred from the 501(c)(3) revenue framing, not explicitly named in the README — validate as a first-call target in early discovery calls
Contract-range estimate ($25K–$300K/year) is BN-internal hypothesis-grade; renewal-rate assumption (>80%) extrapolated from Lightscape's expansion pattern, not BN data

Job postings for Director of Events, Director of Programming, or Seasonal Events Manager
Press coverage of peer-garden Lightscape launches in adjacent markets
RFP issued for holiday event production or seasonal lighting vendor
